findings.suggested_fix: Replace “nyingi, kama si nyingi zaidi” with “nyingi, kama si nyingi kati ya zote” or another phrasing meaning “many, if not most.”

findings.source_quote: “Am I being advised to join others in standing up for our ‘rights’?”
findings.suggested_fix: Change to a question meaning “Am I being advised to join others in standing up for our ‘rights’?”, for example: “Je, ninashauriwa kuungana na wengine kutetea ‘haki’ zetu?”
findings.translation_quote: “Je, nashauriwe kuungana na wengine kutetea ‘haki’ zetu?”

findings.source_quote: “He will NOT allow us to be tempted above that which we are able to bear.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “HATARUHUSU tujaribiwe kupita uwezo wetu wa kustahimili” with a faithful rendering of the source’s promise that God will not allow temptation beyond what we can bear, such as “HATARUHUSU tujaribiwe kupita kiasi tunachoweza kustahimili.”
findings.translation_quote: “HATARUHUSU tujaribiwe kupita uwezo wetu wa kustahimili.”

findings.source_quote: “John S. and Maria (Horning) Kurtz were my great, great grandparents.”
findings.suggested_fix: Change “babu na bibi wa babu yangu” to “babu na bibi wa babu/bibi zangu wa vizazi viwili vilivyopita” or an equivalent conveying “great-great-grandparents.”
findings.translation_quote: “walikuwa babu na bibi wa babu yangu.”
